parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json,b=r.body??r.data??{},built=$('Build Fixed PatEx Examiner Dry Run').first().json,t=b.tableReference,cutoff=new Date(Number(b.lastModifiedTime)).toISOString().slice(0,10),p=built.request.configuration.query.queryParameters.find(x=>x.name==='data_cutoff');if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cutoff)||!p)throw new Error('Hosted PatEx cutoff could not be derived');p.parameterValue.value=cutoff;return [{json:{...built,tableMetadataStatus:r.statusCode,tableMetadata:{projectId:t?.projectId,datasetId:t?.datasetId,tableId:t?.tableId,lastModifiedTime:b.lastModifiedTime,numRows:b.numRows,numBytes:b.numBytes,schema:(b.schema?.fields||[]).map(f=>({name:f.name,type:f.type,mode:f.mode}))}}}];

const r=$input.first().json,b=r.body??r.data??{},meta=$('Attach hosted PatEx schema').first().json;return [{json:{status:r.statusCode,dryRun:true,executedDataQuery:false,jobReference:b.jobReference,statistics:b.statistics,error:b.error,errors:b.errors,tableMetadataStatus:meta.tableMetadataStatus,tableMetadata:meta.tableMetadata,warning:'This checks the fixed PatEx query and estimated bytes only.'}}];
